label: run132 storage as reserve
definition: KEEPER. run131 + the measured storage-AS reserve credit (--ercot-storage-as-reserve), scoped to 2025. storage_as_commitment subtracts ERCOT's battery AS (~2.8 GW in 2025) from the storage power cap, and the co-opt reserve block derives reserve room from that reduced cap — so the committed battery RRS/ECRS is dropped from energy (correct) AND reserve supply (a bug: it is held responsive reserve in ERCOT's RTOLCAP/RTOFFCAP). Crediting it back into the reserve-balance RHS closes the 2025 co-opt over-fire. Scoped to 2025 (a labeled modeling choice, not a measured one): the credit is physically correct every year, but 2023/2024 are keepers whose ORDC tail proxies documented out-of-market scarcity (2023 RTORDPA/ECRS conservatism) an ORDC-only model can't reproduce, so global crediting over-cools them. 2025 LMP MAE 11.3->2.7, avg 43.7->33.9 (act 32.5), tail >200/>500 60/39->8/6 (act 31/3). 2023/2024 byte-identical to run131 (10.5/10.5; tail 151/88, 49/28). Volumes unchanged (DAM-BASE~0); 2025 gas/coal split 76.4% vs 76.0% (EIA-930).
